title: Shopping Cart Discount Bug
description: Customers report incorrect totals when percentage discounts are applied. Follow the checkout flow across the repository to find the cause.
objective: Fix discount calculation without breaking item quantities or checkout behavior.
expectedBehavior: A 20% discount on a $100 subtotal returns $80. Discounts range from 0 to 100 inclusive; values outside that range raise ValueError. Empty carts total zero. Round the final total to two decimal places.
constraints: Use only the Python standard library.
Inputs contain nonnegative item prices and positive integer quantities.
Visible tests are editable. Submit also runs server-managed edge-case tests.
